delivery.title: Ebikwata ku kutuusa - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" wano kitegeeza kyokka nti seva egenderere yazzaayo embeera ya HTTP 2xx - tekakasa nkola efuna ddala yatereka oba yakola ku lead. Kebera omubiri gw’okuddamu waggulu okumanya kye gwayogera ddala; bwe kiba nga tekirina kintu kyonna oba okukkiriza kwokka, enkola eyo eyinza okuba ng’efuna okusaba naye ng’egaana oba ng’ebuusa amaaso omugugu munda (amannya g’ennimiro amakyamu/ensengeka ya API yaayo , ennimiro eyeetaagisa ku ludda lwayo nti payload eno terimu, n’ebirala).

push.title: Webhooks ezifuluma - Push Leads & Ebipya
push.intro: Ekyusibwakyusibwa mu bujjuvu buli webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), oba ekifaananyi kyo eky'omubiri ogwa Custom nga kiriko ebifo <fieldkey></fieldkey> (okugeza <example></example> ) - kikola nga okujjuza ekiragiro cURL omulundi gumu.

push.curlHelp: Teeka ekyokulabirako okusaba API docs zaabwe oba Postman z'ekuwa (nga olina data entuufu oba ey'ekyokulabirako). URL , enkola n’emitwe bikoppololwa nga bwe biri, era buli kisumuluzo mu mubiri kiwandiikiddwa wansi osobole okulonda ekifo kya CRM ekikijjuza ku buli kukulembera.

api.title: API yo - Okuyingira okw'engeri bbiri ku nkola yonna
api.intro: Enkola yonna erimu ekisumuluzo kyo API esobola okukola, okusoma n'okuzza obuggya abakulembeze n'okuwandiika ku bigenda mu maaso ebikulembera. Sindika ekisumuluzo mu mutwe <hdr></hdr> , nga <bearer></bearer> , oba (singa ekintu ekikozesebwa tekisobola kuteeka mitwe) nga <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} okusaba buli ddakiika.
api.noPermission: Omuntu yekka alina olukusa lwa Manage Settings asobola okulaba ekisumuluzo kya API .
api.shownOnce: Koppa ekisumuluzo kino kati okitereke awalala awatali bulabe - olw'obukuumi kiragibwa omulundi gumu gwokka. Bwe kiba nga kibuze, kola empya.
api.regenerateConfirm: Okukola ekisumuluzo kya API ekipya? Ekisumuluzo ekiriwo kati kikoma okukola amangu ddala ku buli nkola ekikozesa.
api.openApiHint: Yingiza OpenAPI spec mu Postman , Zapier , Make oba n8n okufuna buli nkomerero nga yeetegese okukozesa.
